title: Hosted GeoLocker: Pinset Editor and Retention Proof Workbench
creator: Aisha Banerjee
description: Build a Hosted API 'GeoLocker' feature: an ergonomics-focused pinset editor for tenant region binding combined with a Retention Proof Workbench that generates attestation-ready evidence bundles. The feature enables customers to declare explicit region pins for API endpoints, select retention profiles per pinset, preview the downstream data handling and generate downloadable evidence snapshots for audits. This ticket covers the product spec, acceptance criteria, UX flows, and handoff to engineering for the MVP UX + evidence export pipeline.
acceptance_criteria: Pinset editor in Console where tenant admins can create, edit, and version pinsets with one or more region pins (region, priority, soft/strict mode).
Retention profile selector tied to pinsets allowing selection of retention presets (30d, 90d, 1y, custom) and optional TTL per pinset.

Workbench generates a complete evidence snapshot (policy JSON, applied pinset version, retention settings, request routing logs sample) downloadable as a signed bundle within 30s of request for datasets up to 10k events.
Console displays immediate validation warnings when a pinset cannot be honored by current capacity (e.g., no available capacity in pinned region), with suggested fallbacks.
APIs exist for programmatic pinset CRUD and evidence snapshot requests; API documentation and example curl/SDK snippets are published.
End-to-end tests for snapshot generation and edge cases (concurrent edits, rollback to previous pinset) are added to CI.
user_stories: As a tenant admin, I want to declare that my endpoints must stay in the EU so I can meet contract obligations.
As a compliance officer, I want a downloadable proof bundle that shows the active pinset, retention policy, and sampled routing traces so I can respond to audit requests quickly.
As an SRE, I want the Console to warn when a requested pinset would violate capacity constraints so that we avoid silent routing failures.
rollout_plan: Phase 1 (MVP): Console pinset editor + retention selector + evidence snapshot export for single-region pinsets, gated behind feature flag.
Phase 2: Support multi-region pin priorities, API surface stabilization, and evidence packaging improvements (signed attestations).
Canary: Enable for 5 pilot tenants with legal/compliance requirements and run smoke validation for 7 days before broader release.
Monitoring: Add telemetry for pinset creation rate, snapshot generation latency, and evidence download failures to hosted-console dashboard.
engineering_notes: Backend: extend tenancy-configs service with pinset resource and versioning. Pinset schema must be immutable once published (append-only).
Evidence pipeline: reuse snapshot builder from residency-evidence service but add retention metadata and signed manifest. Target generation latency <=30s for 10k events.
Routing: route decision engine must surface simulated routing output for a pinset preview (no actual traffic change).
Data retention: retention enforcement will be a follow-up; MVP only stores retention metadata and emits TTLs to eviction service.
compliance_evidence_flow: User requests snapshot from Workbench UI or /api/v1/pinsets/{id}/snapshot endpoint.

System collects pinned model config, applied routing policy, retention profile, and 24h representative routing logs (redacted PII), signs them with KMS key, and packages into a zip with manifest.json.
Evidence bundle stored in tenant's evidence bucket for 90 days and a download link returned to the user; audit trail entry created in audit-log service.
Operator action: if snapshot generation fails, generate structured incident ticket with failure reason and suggested remediation.
risks: Snapshot may include PII if redaction rules are incomplete — must coordinate with Privacy team for redaction heuristics.
Capacity validation accuracy: if capacity database is stale, Console warnings may be misleading; plan daily sync and freshness checks.
Signed evidence requires KMS integration for hosted customers; key management policy must be validated with Security.
qa_plan: Manual QA on Console: create/edit/publish pinset, attach retention profile, request snapshot, verify contents and signature.
Automated integration test: simulate tenant with 15k small events, request snapshot, assert payload schema and no PII leakage for known test inputs.
Security review checklist: KMS access patterns, signature verification, evidence bundle integrity.
